senses.gloss: order or section of the Scriptures, the portion of the Pentateuch to be read at public service on Sabbaths &c.; in gen. Scripture lesson.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 116b:3">Sabb. 116ᵇ</cite> <he>פסקי ס׳ בכתובים</he> (not <he>דכת׳</he>) they closed the reading from the Pentateuch with a reading from the Hagiographa (v. <cite ref="E00730"><he>הַפְטָרָה</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Yoma 87a:17">Yoma 87ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>הוה פסיק ס׳ וכ׳</he> was reading the Haftarah; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Ketubot 103b:19">Keth. 103ᵇ</cite> <he>אתני סִדְרָךְ לחברך</he> teach thy fellow student the Order which thou hast learned; a. e.—Pl. as ab.
